source: Extracted from the ScholarClone product page (product_details_ScholarClone.html): the P, ROLES, SHIFTS, WHY and FAQS tables.

products.name: Scholar One
products.message: One intelligent platform connecting the entire school
products.pitch: Your school already runs on five separate things: the office, the classroom, the staffroom, the principal’s notebook and the counsellor’s file. Scholar One connects them into one intelligent school, so what happens in each room informs every decision.
benefits: One login, one set of records, no re-entering data
Leaders see learning, staff and operations together
A single rollout and a single partner instead of five vendors
Every product gets better because it shares data with the others
products.fit: Schools that want the full loop and a single partner. Others can start with one product and add the rest.
problems: Schools run five disconnected systems
One platform, one login, shared records
Leaders can’t connect learning, staff and operations
Insight reads all of them; Learn and CCB share teacher data
Each rollout restarts from zero
Single rollout, one training, one support
modules: One login, role-based menus, rights per school
Event bus, notifications, audit, scheduler, files, workflow
SMS, WhatsApp, email, push, biometric, fee gateway

The intelligent-school loop: Learn shows how students are learning

faqs: Do we need all five products?
No. Start with what fits and add more later; Scholar One is for schools that want the full loop.
What does it cost?
Pricing depends on the products and the size of your school. We share it in a personal conversation after a short fit review.
How is rollout done?
A forward-deployed team works with your school through implementation. We do not install and leave.

products.name: Scholar Core
products.message: Simplify and intelligently manage school operations
products.pitch: Scholar Core takes the paperwork out of running a school. Admissions, fees, attendance, exams, transport, library and parent communication live in one system, so your office team spends time on people, not registers.
benefits: Fewer missed fees and faster collection follow-up
Admission enquiries tracked from first call to confirmation
Report cards and results prepared in one flow
Parents get notices and updates without calling the office
Principal sees the day’s school on one dashboard
products.fit: Start here if your biggest pain is operations. Add Learn, CCB, Insight and Compass later on the same records.

products.name: Scholar Learn
products.message: Make learning more personalised, measurable and adaptive
products.pitch: Scholar Learn gives every student a personal learning path. It finds the exact concepts a child is missing, explains why, and gives practice that adapts, while teachers plan lessons, set homework and see who needs help.
benefits: Gaps found early, concept by concept, not after the exam
Teachers see why a student is stuck, not just the marks
Interactive practice keeps students engaged
Less time on lesson plans, worksheets and question papers with AI help
Parents can follow their child’s progress
products.fit: Start here if your focus is learning outcomes. In Scholar One, Learn also feeds Insight, Compass and CCB.
problems: The whole class is taught at one speed, so some are lost and some are bored
Adaptive quiz and concept-level mastery show each student’s level
We only find learning gaps after the exam
Chapter diagnostic and concept-level results show gaps early

benefits: Real skill gaps for each role, not guesses
Training matched to the gap and tracked to completion
Fairer, structured appraisals
Clear career and succession paths for good staff
Leave, payroll and tasks in the same place

products.name: Scholar Insight
products.message: Turn school information into better institutional decisions
products.pitch: Scholar Insight is your school’s brain. It connects student, learning, staff and operations data into one knowledge graph and helps leaders trace a problem to its root and decide with evidence.
benefits: One connected view across the whole school
Trace weak results back to the root concept
Decisions recorded with their evidence
Ask questions in plain language
Knowledge stays with the school when people leave
products.fit: Insight is strongest on top of Core, Learn and CCB data, so it is the natural centre of Scholar One.
problems: Data sits in separate systems and nobody sees the whole picture
Foundation data plus a graph that links students, people, curriculum and results
Leaders decide on gut feel
Executive analytics, decision intelligence and signals with evidence
Knowledge leaves with people
Knowledge library, memory and AI assistant
